Discussed district courts, High Courts, and the Supreme Court.

end.parentNote: Vihaan practised the court structure, appeal pathway, and the difference between a criminal case and other cases. They explained that an appeal moves upward from District Court to High Court and then Supreme Court; no mix-up was recorded, but the teach-back was not completed because the visual diagram was unavailable. At home, draw three boxes—District Court, High Court, and Supreme Court—with upward arrows, then ask Vihaan to explain the pathway.
